name: Redirecting Palm (Combat, Technique)
body:
A weapon can be a dangerous thing to allies as well as foes with just the slightest wrong movement.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Reflexes, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +6

Benefit(s): When you successfully hit an opponent with an unarmed strike, you may attempt to deflect one of their missed attacks into another creature or object on their next turn. If the creature misses you with a melee attack on their next turn, you may spend one attack of opportunity to select one target within the creature’s reach or adjacent to you other than the attacker. Compare the attack roll against the target’s AC. If it would hit the target, the attack hits and deals damage to the new target.
